issues.claim: qa.md still has S2 and S6 verification constraints
issues.evidence: qa.md (33 lines) contains S7 verbatim (lines 48-49) and the live-verification mandate (line 42), but does NOT contain: (a) the verbatim 4 user requirements list, (b) S2 (scope policy whitelist for codexToolRendering.ts:26-28), or (c) S6 (attachment file-type semantics decision). grep for 'S2.', 'S6.', 'MCP elicitation', 'tool rendering', 'attachments', 'scope-leak', 'whitelist' returns NOT FOUND. grep for 'four|requirement|MCP|attachment|rendering|scope' returns only 2 matches (line 36 QA history mentioning 'codex-rendering' filename, line 42 saying 'each of the four' without listing them). QA verifier cannot verify requirement 2 (rendering -- needs S2) or requirement 3 (attachments -- needs S6).
issues.violates: Anti-Fraud Principle 3 (verify FULL acceptance criteria); explicit round-3 brief instruction 'QA must still be able to verify all 4 user requirements (S2 and S6 referenced or kept verbatim)'
issues.remediation: Re-add S2 and S6 to qa.md as QA-style verification checks (paraphrased, not verbatim copy of ba.md prose) so ba-vs-qa overlap stays < 30%. Example: 'Verify Grep/Glob/WebSearch hidden AND Codex unknown/resource shown per S2 whitelist'; 'Verify image attachment delivered as localImage; verify S6 file-type decision is documented'.

caveat: qa.md is functionally incomplete on requirements 2 and 3 (rendering, attachments). When dev cycle starts, /dev orchestrator or QA agent must read the monolith Section 5 directly to obtain the S2 and S6 verification scope, OR the user must request a manual qa.md re-edit before the cycle starts.
